recruitmentRules.poolDefinition: all global Free Agents with finalOverall >=75 from data/FREE_AGENTS_compact.json plus all Orion recruitment profiles supplied in PULL_SVINCOLATI; dedupe by canonical playerId; Orion profile wins overlap

initialDraft.selectionRule: global Free Agents require finalOverall >=75; Orion recruitment profiles have no minimum; no maximum OVR

pullFreeAgents.selectionRule: global_free_agent finalOverall >= max(75,current progressive minimum); Orion recruitment profiles remain eligible regardless of progressive minimum; no maximum OVR

effectivePoolStrategy.globalFilter: finalOverall >= 75 for Draft; max(75, current progressive minimum) for Pull
